# Volume 2 timeline

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is daydreaming on her porch when Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) furiously confronts her about her cow breaking into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retorts about his baldness before agreeing to keep the cow secured. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss the encounter over tea alongside news of new residents moving into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Stephen Irving's young son coming to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plans to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) cautions against, and the news that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) will be teaching at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their plans for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) while driving home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). Spotting a cow in Mr. Harrison's grain field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) thinking it is her own cow, Dolly. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers Dolly is still in the pen and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake, leading her to set off to apologize with a peace-offering cake.

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow instead of her own, and offers her own cow in exchange. To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts her cake, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a friendly meal and clearing up the misunderstanding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to recount her successful evening.

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — On the eve of the school year, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate teaching methods, particularly whether corporal punishment is ever justified. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home, stops to visit Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)—who also doubts her gentle discipline approach—and goes to bed feeling anxious about her first day as a teacher. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and gives her advice before she sets off.

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Morley, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, taking note of her new students, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, an eccentric mother, Mrs. Donnell, visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is cheered by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) presenting her with flowers, and later discusses the day's events with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel around to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), collecting subscriptions for repairs to the local hall. Along the way, they encounter various eccentric neighbors, including the pessimistic [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimistic sister Catherine, a flustered Mr. Blair whom they help bake a cake, and the excessively neat Mrs. Theodore White.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) neighbors for subscriptions to the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), facing various eccentric and difficult residents. They seize an opportunity at Lorenzo White's house following the birth of his new son and secure a generous five-dollar donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) makes one final attempt by visiting Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), though he flatly refuses to contribute.

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their writing, teaching experiences with students like [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), and their ambitions for the future. Later, after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the possibility of temporarily taking in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md).

## IX A Question of Color

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), Aid Society** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives home with the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose contrasting behaviors quickly manifest during dinner and bedtime. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates chaos throughout his first week, first by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church and later by tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen before attempting to pump water on her. After being sent to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also placed a toad in Marilla's bed, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frantically removes.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed out of mischief. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily retrieves the toad with a fire shovel and releases it in the cherry orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices, after which she spots [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling to her from her window.

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), Improvers, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), Pyes, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md), [Timothy Cotton](../character/timothy-cotton.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a peaceful walk home along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and chats with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted for his trickery and lying, eventually breaking down in remorse and promising to reform before being sent to bed.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about telling falsehoods after he tries to test Marilla's warning about skipping prayers. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joke with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they discuss the challenges of raising the twins, admitting that despite his mischief, they both prefer [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) over the perfectly behaved [Dora](../character/dora.md).

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her amusing experiences as a teacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny anecdotes about her students' responses in class and transcribes several composition letters written by her pupils, including an overly dramatic one from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied from old love letters and an imaginative letter from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) describing his fictional rock friends.

**[Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md)** — In his letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) describes his imaginary rock friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailor.md). He details a fantastical journey to the sunset in an enchanted boat with the oldest [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md). He concludes his letter by clarifying to his teacher that the story isn't actually true.

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — In an irritable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing fireworks to explode in the classroom and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Returning home in despair, she confesses to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who comforts her and reassures her that everyone makes mistakes. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is amazed to find that whipping Anthony actually won his respect, a fact later confirmed by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) on a spring walk across the woods and fields to celebrate her adopted birthday. During their excursion, the girls explore unfamiliar paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's hidden old garden. Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant love story of Hester and [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jordan](../character/jordan.md), [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends discuss Hester Gray's story and imagine what she looked like before leaving their baskets in the garden. They explore the surrounding woods and fields, enjoying lunch and deep conversation by a brook. At sunset, they head home, feeling content with their memorable day.

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and Marilla's improving eyesight. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learn that the twins' uncle cannot take them until autumn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps correct Davy's funny theological misunderstandings after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the members are appalled to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) fail to persuade him otherwise.

**[Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) try to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he initially refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad contract in exchange for her silence, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to report a successful outcome to the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers).

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and meets [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as she walks to the graveyard to place flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves. On her way, she converses with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) about his family and imagination. Later, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on her walk home, where they discuss teaching, ideals, college plans, and the meaning of true friendship.

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) corrects Davy's confused idea about heaven before sharing exciting news from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) handle the meal, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends the next day diligently cleaning the house and preparing the food with help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md).

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and a grand dinner for the guest of honor, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and the dinner suffers from cooking mishaps and damaged property. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, making sense of the day's disappointment.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Following the party guests' departure, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss handling the broken platter, local gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), and life's disappointments before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals her to come over with news about a potential replacement willow-ware platter. The two girls travel along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) to search for the platter at the old Copp homestead. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) climbs onto an old duckhouse roof to look into the pantry window and gets stuck, a rainstorm hits, but she stays amused by writing a story until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and helps free her.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp for looking into her window before negotiating to buy her old platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) accepts twenty-five dollars for it and reveals she is planning to get married. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive back along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), laughing about their afternoon adventure.

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins to the shore with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, reassuring him about his imaginative thoughts. When she returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she helps a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his bedtime prayers and reassures him of her affection. Later at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and notices how much [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has grown up.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finish talking with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) before walking down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where she meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to discuss their ideals and the progress of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the upcoming day and the return to school.

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) depart for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and prepares to transfer feathers between ticks, accidentally dying her nose red in a mishap with carpet dye. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to compose herself despite her disheveled appearance. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) host the guests, and they all enjoy a pleasant dinner and a scenic walk before the visitors leave.

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom incidents involving [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md). Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost while walking to tea in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton) and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the secluded home of Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss Lavendar warmly invites them to stay for a pretend tea party she had set up to cure her loneliness.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a tea party with Miss Lavendar and her helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss Lavendar demonstrates the garden's famous echoes and explains how her helpers came to share the same name. Before departing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), causing a sudden quiet reaction in Miss Lavendar, who gives the girls lavender as they leave.

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), her past relationship with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the health of [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) while managing Davy's poor table manners. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dyed feathers for an Indian headdress to keep him happy. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), which ensures they can stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a winter evening to stay with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. During a cozy evening by the fire, Miss Lavendar confides the story of her past romance and falling-out with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond during a delightful visit.

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md)** — After a newspaper item pokes fun at Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a sudden and devastating severe hail storm hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, only to find extensive damage to crops, trees, and windows across the village. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) grieves the loss of his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the community takes stock of the destruction.

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — A surprising visitor arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and announces that she is his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), leading to rumors and curiosity. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who sheepishly admits he is glad his wife has returned before preparing to explain the full story of their past separation.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated after arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and his swearing parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), though they have now reconciled. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) returns with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, and expresses her joy at being back with her husband. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hears the latest gossip from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before putting a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passes away, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Upon learning of Anne's resignation from teaching, her pupils react with distress, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a quiet conversation discussing the upcoming changes and their enduring friendship.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxiety about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for college and asks if [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clarifies that she sees [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) only as a friend and describes her romantic ideals, leading to gossip about Ruby Gillis's suitors. Finally, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) fondly recall the beginning of their friendship and reaffirm their devotion to each other.

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chat during dinner about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and general curiosities before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There, they are warmly welcomed by Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth for afternoon food and conversation. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head off to pick wild strawberries.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) her worries about Miss Lavendar's listlessness and recent change in behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come spend a week at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after her vacation starts to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. After tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imagined dream-boy, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [William Bell](../character/william-bell.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Gracie](../character/gracie.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her two-year term as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher, prompting the local village women to gossip about the town's future, her pupils' love for her, and Stephen Irving's sudden arrival in town. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to relay a message to Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the message to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help a nervous Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare Miss Lavendar for Stephen Irving's arrival. Stephen arrives and speaks briefly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before meeting with Miss Lavendar in the parlor. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) keep themselves busy in the kitchen until they look outside and see Stephen and Miss Lavendar together on the garden bench, happily reunited.

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.

## Chapter 32

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before heading to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to help Miss Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for the wedding. The wedding ceremony takes place in the garden, attended by guests including Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) return to lock up the house and share a quiet, romantic moment together.
